properties.explanation: NYC Parks recorded an actual completion milestone for a capital project at the cited park or public-realm site.

properties.title: Penn Station East End Gateway opened
properties.short_description: MTA Construction & Development announced the grand opening of the East End Gateway to the LIRR concourse at Penn Station on 31 December 2020.
properties.explanation: A new high-capacity Seventh Avenue entrance, escalator, stair, and direct street-to-concourse route entered passenger use at Penn Station.

properties.title: Pier 26 opened in Hudson River Park
properties.short_description: Hudson River Park records the official opening of Pier 26 on 30 September 2020.
properties.explanation: A new ecological pier and public waterfront space entered use in Tribeca.

properties.title: Public School 48 was designated an individual landmark
properties.short_description: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission announced designation of Public School 48 at 155-02 108th Avenue in South Jamaica, Queens as an individual landmark on September 22, 2020.
properties.explanation: A documented LPC action changed the listed preservation status of Public School 48 to individual landmark.

properties.title: Pugsley Creek sewer cleanup project completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC and DEP announced on 27 October 2020 that a Pugsley Creek sewer and water-main project in the South Bronx had been completed ahead of schedule.
properties.explanation: A major sewer, water-main, sidewalk, curb, and roadway restoration project tied to Pugsley Creek reached documented completion.

properties.title: Rosedale infrastructure project neared completion
properties.short_description: NYC DDC and DEP announced on 4 March 2020 that a Rosedale, Queens infrastructure project was near completion and expected to finish in spring 2020.
properties.explanation: The documented project covered new and replacement storm sewers, combined sewers, catch basins, water mains, manholes, accessways, roadway overlay, and planting.

properties.title: Special Flushing Waterfront District zoning was adopted
properties.short_description: NYC Council and Zoning Resolution records show N 200034 ZRQ establishing the Special Flushing Waterfront District, with Council approval on December 10, 2020.
properties.explanation: A documented special-purpose zoning district change was recorded for the Downtown Flushing waterfront.

properties.title: 44 Union Square completed the former Tammany Hall expansion
properties.short_description: Commercial Observer reported on 5 October 2020 that the long-running Tammany Hall renovation and glass-dome expansion at 44 Union Square was complete.
properties.explanation: A landmarked former political-club and theatre building re-entered the Union Square office and retail market after restoration and expansion.

properties.title: Utica Avenue SBS corridor upgrades were completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC and DOT announced on 11 February 2020 that a 22.7 million USD project upgrading the Utica Avenue Select Bus Service corridor had been completed.
properties.explanation: A documented transit-street upgrade completed bus pads, bus bulbs, neckdowns, traffic islands, curb extensions, sidewalks, street lighting, signals, markings, water mains, hydrants, and catch basins.

properties.title: West Cedarview Avenue drainage project began
properties.short_description: NYC DDC and DEP announced on 9 July 2020 that a Richmond, Staten Island drainage and infrastructure project had begun on and around West Cedarview Avenue.
properties.explanation: The construction-start record covered new storm sewers, catch basins, sanitary sewers, water mains, roadway restoration, sidewalks, curbs, and new trees.

properties.title: West Tremont Avenue Step Street reopened after restoration
properties.short_description: NYC DDC and DOT announced on 7 April 2020 that the West Tremont Avenue Step Street restoration in Morris Heights had been completed.
properties.explanation: A documented restoration reopened a historic Bronx step street, adding new granite steps, landings, lighting, benches, handrails, landscaping, drainage, and adjacent street work.

properties.title: Zion Triangle Plaza expansion completed in Brownsville
properties.short_description: NYC DOT, DDC, and Parks celebrated completion of a 5.7 million USD expansion and enhancement of Zion Triangle Plaza on 10 November 2020.
properties.explanation: A permanent pedestrian plaza expansion reached documented completion with new pedestrian space, curb extension, seating, planting, lighting, water fountain, rain gardens, and restored war memorial.
